text:
Mia Chen: Heads-up, p99 is spiking in the console but endpoint breakdown shows a flat line. They don't line up for the same time window. Anyone else seeing this?

Sahil Rao: I saw it earlier. My hunch is routing fallback — console rollup uses merged tdigest while the endpoint pane is showing raw samples by backend. mixed origins.

Anna P.: Can you paste the query windows? Could be smoothing/window mismatch (sparkline vs percentile view use different aggregation intervals).

Jordan Lee: Also check quota fallbacks — if requests get routed to the dedicated fallback pool they have a different latency distribution. That can nudge the tail even at low traffic %s.

Mia Chen: window was 5m aligned to 10s buckets. Screenshot: https://console.redwood.ai/d/abc123/latency?view=overview (placeholder)

Sahil Rao: Proposal: add a small "sample-origin" legend/badge and SLO band overlay. Badge shows ingress/backend/fallback split and raw sample counts. Low-effort but very high signal.

Anna P.: +1. UX: show SLO bands for p95/p99 on the chart and in the tooltip list sample counts by origin and by route. Also add an automatic annotation when routing weight/fallbacks change.

Jordan Lee: technical caveat: tdigest rollups can understate the tail if shards have uneven sample counts. Example: if 98% traffic at 50ms and 2% at 500ms in a separate shard, merged sketch p99 may not reflect that without origin-aware weighting.

Mia Chen: can we add a "Why did my p99 change?" flyout that lists likely causes: routing policy change, quota failover, smoothing window differences, tdigest compression artifacts, low sample counts. Actionable links to traces and rollout logs.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: deploy finished "frontend/latency-badge" to prod at 1779990045 :white_check_mark:

Sahil Rao: I'll open a tiny PR to add the sample-origin badge + SLO overlay and an annotation hook for routing-weight changes. tagging @Anna P. and @Jordan Lee for review.

Anna P.: Thanks — please also add a telemetry test that injects synthetic slow-fanout to validate raw vs rollup p99 differences before we GA.

Jordan Lee: I'll add a weekly telemetry job: simulate 2% slow-fanout and compare raw samples vs tdigest-merged p99; alert if discrepancy > 10%.

Mia Chen: thanks team. If we can ship the badge/annotation today it should cut down pager volume and make the root-cause easier. :pray:
